title: Bound automatic mailbox admissions performed by one directory request
outcome: A first directory/MCP read on a host with many roots performs bounded admission work and exposes incomplete inventory explicitly without weakening aliases.
acceptance: One directory request has a documented bound on newly admitted roots or uses the existing lifecycle's incremental reconciliation, without a parallel session authority.
Large-inventory regression proves request progress and explicit incomplete-host reporting; global aliases refuse while incomplete and complete catalogs keep ordinary addressing.
